verses.sloka: स बभुव कृशो राजा मैथिलीकाममोहितः ।असन्मानाच्च सुहृदाम् पापः पापेन कर्मणाः ॥६-११-१॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa babhuva kṛśo rājā maithilīkāmamohitaḥ ।asanmānācca suhṛdām pāpaḥ pāpena karmaṇāḥ ॥6-11-1॥।।

translations.english: Infatuated with passion towards Mythili, disregarded by his dear ones on account of sinful actions, sinner Ravana became weak.

verses.sloka: अतीतसमये काले तस्मिन्वे युधि रावणः ।अमात्यैश्च सुहृद्भिश्च प्राप्तकालममन्यत ॥६-११-२॥।।
verses.transliteration: atītasamaye kāle tasminve yudhi rāvaṇaḥ ।amātyaiśca suhṛdbhiśca prāptakālamamanyata ॥6-11-2॥।।

translations.english: Because of the lapse of time, Ravana considered it imminent to consult with his ministers and friends about war.

verses.sloka: स हेमजालविततम् मणिविद्रुमभूषितम् ।उपगम्य विनीताश्वमारुरोह महार्थम् ॥६-११-३॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa hemajālavitatam maṇividrumabhūṣitam ।upagamya vinītāśvamāruroha mahārtham ॥6-11-3॥।।

translations.english: Ravana, having reached, ascended the magnificent chariot that was overlaid with golden latticework, decked with gems and corals, and yoked to trained horses.
translations.hindi: तढुपरान्त, सुबर्ण की जालियों से भूपित, मूंगों और मणियों से शोभित और शिक्षित घोड़ों से युक्त बढ़े रथ पर रावण सवार हुआ

verses.sloka: तमास्थाय रथश्रेष्ठो महामेघसमस्वनम् ।प्रययौ रक्षसाम् श्रेष्ठो दशग्रीवः सभाम् प्रति ॥६-११-४॥।।
verses.transliteration: tamāsthāya rathaśreṣṭho mahāmeghasamasvanam ।prayayau rakṣasām śreṣṭho daśagrīvaḥ sabhām prati ॥6-11-4॥।।

translations.english: The tenheaded Ravana, eminent one among Rakshasas climbed up that best of chariots that was making noise like the roaring sound of a huge cloud and went to assembly.
translations.hindi: उस मेघ फे समान शब्द करते हुए श्रेष्ठ रथ पर चढ़ कर, दशवदन राक्षसश्रेछ रावण सभाभवन की ओर चला

verses.sloka: असिचर्मधरा योधाः सर्वायुधधरास्ततः ।राक्षसा राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पुरस्तात्सम्प्रतस्थिरे ॥६-११-५॥।।
verses.transliteration: asicarmadharā yodhāḥ sarvāyudhadharāstataḥ ।rākṣasā rākṣasendrasya purastātsampratasthire ॥6-11-5॥।।

translations.english: Then soldiers wielding swords and different kinds of weapons stood in front of the Lord of Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: नानाविकृतवेषाश्च नानाभूषणभूषिताः ।पार्श्वतः पृष्ठतश्चैनम् परिवार्य ययुस्तदा ॥६-११-६॥।।
verses.transliteration: nānāvikṛtaveṣāśca nānābhūṣaṇabhūṣitāḥ ।pārśvataḥ pṛṣṭhataścainam parivārya yayustadā ॥6-11-6॥।।

translations.english: Further (Rakshasas) adorned in different kinds of uncouth attire, wearing different kinds of ornaments went by his side and also at the back.
translations.hindi: विकट वेषधारी अनेक भूषण पहने हुए अनेक राक्षस अगल बगल और आगे पीछे रावण को घेर कर चले

verses.sloka: रथैश्चातिरथा शीघ्रम् मतैश्च वरवारणैः ।अमात्पेतुर्दशग्रीवमाक्रीडद्भिश्च वाजिभिः ॥६-११-७॥।।
verses.transliteration: rathaiścātirathā śīghram mataiśca varavāraṇaiḥ ।amātpeturdaśagrīvamākrīḍadbhiśca vājibhiḥ ॥6-11-7॥।।

translations.english: (Some Rakshasa) Charioteers riding on chariots, some on proud elephants and some on horses sporting away followed the tenheaded Ravana.
translations.hindi: महारथी राक्षस शीघ्रतापूर्वेक रथों और मतवाले हाथियों पर तथा खेल कूद करने वाले घोड़ों पर सवार हो रावण के साथ चले

verses.sloka: गदापरिघहस्ताश्च शक्तितोमरपाणयः ।परश्वथधराश्चान्ये तथान्ये शूलपाणयः ॥६-११-८॥।।
verses.transliteration: gadāparighahastāśca śaktitomarapāṇayaḥ ।paraśvathadharāścānye tathānye śūlapāṇayaḥ ॥6-11-8॥।।

translations.english: Some holding maces and iron bars, some holding strong iron clubs in hand, and some others holding battle axes, tridents and other weapons went.
translations.hindi: बे लोग हाथों सें गदा, परिघ, शक्ति, तोमर, परश्वध और शूल आदि हथियार लिये हुए थे

verses.sloka: ततस्तूर्यसहस्राणाम् सम्जज्ञे निःस्वनो महान् ।तुमुलः शङ्खशब्दश्च सभाम् गच्चति रवणे ॥६-११-९॥।।
verses.transliteration: tatastūryasahasrāṇām samjajñe niḥsvano mahān ।tumulaḥ śaṅkhaśabdaśca sabhām gaccati ravaṇe ॥6-11-9॥।।

translations.english: Then as Ravana entered the assembly thousands of band instruments sounded aloud. Conchs broke forth producing tumultuous noise.

verses.sloka: स नेमिघोषेण महान्सहसाभिनिनादयन् ।राजमार्गम् श्रिया जुष्टम् प्रतिपेदे महारथः ॥६-११-१०॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa nemighoṣeṇa mahānsahasābhininādayan ।rājamārgam śriyā juṣṭam pratipede mahārathaḥ ॥6-11-10॥।।

translations.english: As the rattling sounds of the great chariot echoed in all directions, he entered the bright pleasing royal path all at once.

verses.sloka: विमलम् चातपत्रम् च पगृहीतमशोभत ।पाण्डुरम् राक्षसेन्द्रस्य पूर्णस्तारधिपो यथा ॥६-११-११॥।।
verses.transliteration: vimalam cātapatram ca pagṛhītamaśobhata ।pāṇḍuram rākṣasendrasya pūrṇastāradhipo yathā ॥6-11-11॥।।

translations.english: The pure white canopy of Ravana held by the Rakshasas spread like lines shone like the Lord of stars (the full moon).
translations.hindi: राक्तसराज रावण के मःतक पर श्वेत वर्ण का प्रकाशमान छत्र, विमल पूर्णिमा के चन्द्रमा की तरह शोभायमान हो रहा था

verses.sloka: हेमञ्जरिगर्भे च शुद्धस्फटिकविग्रहे ।चामरव्यजने तस्य रेजतुः सव्यदक्षिणे ॥६-११-१२॥।।
verses.transliteration: hemañjarigarbhe ca śuddhasphaṭikavigrahe ।cāmaravyajane tasya rejatuḥ savyadakṣiṇe ॥6-11-12॥।।

translations.english: A pair of fans with pure crystal like handles with a golden bouquet in the middle glowed.
translations.hindi: रावण के अगल वगल सोने के सूत्रों से भूषित और उज्वल डंडी से वने हुए दो चमर ओर पंखे डलाये जा रहे थे

verses.sloka: ते कृताञ्जलयः सर्वे रथस्थम् पृथिवीस्थिताः ।राक्ष्सा राक्षसश्रेष्ठम् शिरोभिस्तम् ववन्दिरे ॥६-११-१३॥।।
verses.transliteration: te kṛtāñjalayaḥ sarve rathastham pṛthivīsthitāḥ ।rākṣsā rākṣasaśreṣṭham śirobhistam vavandire ॥6-11-13॥।।

translations.english: Standing on the ground, all the Rakshasas bowing their heads down and with folded palms offered their salutations to the foremost of the Rakshasas seated in the chariot.
translations.hindi: रास्ते में बहुत से राक्षस हाथ जाडे खड़े थे और जब रथ सामने आता तब वे रथ में सवार रावण को झुक झुक कर प्रणाम करते थे

verses.sloka: राक्षनैः स्तूयमानः सन् जयाशीर्भिररिम्दमः ।अससाद महातेजाः सभाम् विरचिताम् तदा ॥६-११-१४॥।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣanaiḥ stūyamānaḥ san jayāśīrbhirarimdamaḥ ।asasāda mahātejāḥ sabhām viracitām tadā ॥6-11-14॥।।

translations.english: Then as the conqueror of foes, an exceptionally splendid one, Ravana was praised by the Rakshasas saying, "Victory to you, Prosperity to you", Ravana entered the wellbuilt royal court.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार राक्षसों द्वारा सम्मानित ओर विजय के लिए आशी- वाद्‌ सुनता हुआ शत्रुदमनकारी एवं महातेजस्वी रावण सुन्दर बने हुए शुभ सभाभवन में पहुंचा

verses.sloka: सुवर्णरजतास्तीर्णाम् विशुद्धस्फटिकान्तराम् ।विराजमानो वपुषा रुक्मपट्टोत्तरच्चदाम् ॥६-११-१५॥।।
verses.transliteration: suvarṇarajatāstīrṇām viśuddhasphaṭikāntarām ।virājamāno vapuṣā rukmapaṭṭottaraccadām ॥6-11-15॥।।

translations.english: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.
translations.hindi: का सध्यभाग स्फटिक पत्थर का बना हुआ था ओर उसके ऊपर सनहले रुपहले काप का फश EEN हुआ था। शरीर को सजाय हुप ओर छः सौ पिशाचो द्वारा राक्तत वह महातेजस्वी रावण वश्व कसा क बनाए सभापवन म गया

verses.sloka: ताम् पिशाचशतैः षड्भिरभिगुप्ताम् सदाप्रभाम् ।प्रविवेश महातेजाः सुकृताम् विश्वकर्मणा ॥६-११-१६॥।।
verses.transliteration: tām piśācaśataiḥ ṣaḍbhirabhiguptām sadāprabhām ।praviveśa mahātejāḥ sukṛtām viśvakarmaṇā ॥6-11-16॥।।

translations.english: Exceptionally splendid one, (Ravana) embodied with glowing body entered the royal court constructed by Vishwakarma, with pillars of gold and silver. Inside of the court was pure like crystal and carpeted with shining golden silk. It was very beautiful and ever shining and guarded by six hundred devils.

verses.sloka: तस्याम् स वैदूर्यमयम् प्रियाकाजिनसम्वृतम् ।महत्सोपाश्रयम् भेजे रावणः परमासनम् ॥६-११-१७॥।।
verses.transliteration: tasyām sa vaidūryamayam priyākājinasamvṛtam ।mahatsopāśrayam bheje rāvaṇaḥ paramāsanam ॥6-11-17॥।।

translations.english: Ravana sat on a huge excellent seat encrusted with Vydurya gems and covered with deer skin and which had a pillow.

verses.sloka: ततः शशासेश्वरवद्दूतान् लघुपराक्रमान् ।समानयत मे क्षिप्रमिहैतान् राक्षसानिति ॥६-११-१८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ śaśāseśvaravaddūtān laghuparākramān ।samānayata me kṣipramihaitān rākṣasāniti ॥6-11-18॥।।

translations.english: Then that Lord like Ravana said "We have to do a great task against the enemies now. It has to be performed." He commanded quick footed messengers to get the Rakshasas to him at once.
translations.hindi: सभाभवन के फरशा सभाभवन में पहुँच रावण पन्नों क जड़ाऊ [सहांखन पर, जिसके ऊपर प्रियक जाति के हिरन का कोमल चम बिछा हुआ था और मतनद लगा हुआ था-जा बैठा

verses.sloka: कृत्यमस्ति महाज्जाने कर्तव्यमिति शत्रुभिः ।राक्षसास्तद्वचः श्रुत्वा लङ्कायाम् परिचक्रमुः ॥६-११-१९॥।।
verses.transliteration: kṛtyamasti mahājjāne kartavyamiti śatrubhiḥ ।rākṣasāstadvacaḥ śrutvā laṅkāyām paricakramuḥ ॥6-11-19॥।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.

verses.sloka: अनुगेहमवस्थय विहारशयनेषु च ।उद्यानेषु च रक्क्षम्सि चोदयन्तो ह्यभीतवत् ॥६-११-२०॥।।
verses.transliteration: anugehamavasthaya vihāraśayaneṣu ca ।udyāneṣu ca rakkṣamsi codayanto hyabhītavat ॥6-11-20॥।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas having heard the words spoken by Ravana went to places of recreation, bedrooms and gardens and went round without fear into every house directing the Rakshasas.
translations.hindi: विहार में रत, सोते हुए, उद्यानां में खेलते हुए, राक्षसों में राह्सेश्वर की आज्ञा का प्रचार निर्भीक हो करने लगे

verses.sloka: ते रथान् रुचिरानेके दृप्तानेके दृढान् हयान् ।नागनेकेऽधिरुरुहुर्जग्मुश्चैके पदातयः ॥६-११-२१॥।।
verses.transliteration: te rathān rucirāneke dṛptāneke dṛḍhān hayān ।nāganeke'dhiruruhurjagmuścaike padātayaḥ ॥6-11-21॥।।

translations.english: Of those (Rakshasas) some went on exquisite chariots, some on proud sturdy horses some ascended elephants and some by foot.
translations.hindi: राक्षसेश्वर की आज्ञा पाते ही उन राक्षसों में कोई रथ पए, कोई अलग घोड़ों पर, कोई हाथियों पर और कोई पेटल हो चल दिए

verses.sloka: सा पुरी परमाकीर्णा रथकुञ्जरवाजिभिः ।सम्पतद्भिर्विरुरुचे गरुत्मद्चिरिवामबरम् ॥६-११-२२॥।।
verses.transliteration: sā purī paramākīrṇā rathakuñjaravājibhiḥ ।sampatadbhirviruruce garutmadcirivāmabaram ॥6-11-22॥।।

translations.english: With chariots, elephants and horses advancing in groups the prosperous capital was shining resembling the flocks of birds in the sky.
translations.hindi: उस समय लङ्कापुरी रथ, हाथी और घोड़ा से ऐसी शोभा पा रही थी; जैसे गरुडों से आकाश शोभायमान होता है

verses.sloka: ते वाहनान्यवस्थाप्य यानानि विविधानि च ।सभाम् पद्भिः प्रविविशुः सिम्हा गिरिगुहामिव ॥६-११-२३॥।।
verses.transliteration: te vāhanānyavasthāpya yānāni vividhāni ca ।sabhām padbhiḥ praviviśuḥ simhā giriguhāmiva ॥6-11-23॥।।

translations.english: Parking those vehicles of several kinds at the entrance they entered the royal court by foot like the lions entering the cave of a mountain.

verses.sloka: राज्ञः पादौ गृहीत्वा तु राज्ञा ते प्रतिपूजिताः ।पीठेष्वन्ये बृसीष्वन्ये भूमौ केचिदुपाविशन् ॥६-११-२४॥।।
verses.transliteration: rājñaḥ pādau gṛhītvā tu rājñā te pratipūjitāḥ ।pīṭheṣvanye bṛsīṣvanye bhūmau kecidupāviśan ॥6-11-24॥।।

translations.english: They held the feet of the king and on offering salutations to the king took their seat. While some took golden seats, some sat on a kusa grass mat, and some took a se at on the floor.

verses.sloka: ते समेत्य सभायाम् वै राक्षसा राजशासनात् ।यथार्हमुपतस्थुस्ते रावणम् राक्षसाधिपम् ॥६-११-२५॥।।
verses.transliteration: te sametya sabhāyām vai rākṣasā rājaśāsanāt ।yathārhamupatasthuste rāvaṇam rākṣasādhipam ॥6-11-25॥।।

translations.english: Those Rakshasas (who arrived) at the royal court settled down in appropriate seats on the king's command. The leaders of Rakshasas s at close by Ravana.
translations.hindi: इस प्रकार रा्वासराज को आज्ञा से वे. सब वहाँ एकत्र हो यथाक्रम रावण के समीप बेठे

verses.sloka: मन्त्रिणश्च यथामुख्या निश्चितार्थेषु पण्डिताः ।अमात्याश्च गुणोपेताः सर्वज्ञा बुद्धिदर्शनाः ॥६-११-२६॥।।
verses.transliteration: mantriṇaśca yathāmukhyā niścitārtheṣu paṇḍitāḥ ।amātyāśca guṇopetāḥ sarvajñā buddhidarśanāḥ ॥6-11-26॥।।

translations.english: Those who were learned in decision making, ministers, virtuous and knowledgeable ones, those who can visualise things with their intellect, army men, like wise many heroes and important people collected at the royal assembly shining in golden colour to deliberate on matters for a happy conclusion.
translations.hindi: अच्छे अच्छे मंत्री सब विषयों में निपुण ओर गुणज्ञ, सर्वज्ञ ओर अत्यन्त बुद्धिमान यथाक्रम उस सभा में बेठे हुए थे

verses.sloka: समीयुस्तत्र शतशः शूराश्च बहवस्तथा ।सभायाम् हेमवर्णायाम् सर्वार्थस्य सुखाय वै ॥६-११-२७॥।।
verses.transliteration: samīyustatra śataśaḥ śūrāśca bahavastathā ।sabhāyām hemavarṇāyām sarvārthasya sukhāya vai ॥6-11-27॥।।

translations.english: Those who were learned in decision making, ministers, virtuous and knowledgeable ones, those who can visualise things with their intellect, army men, like wise many heroes and important people collected at the royal assembly shining in golden colour to deliberate on matters for a happy conclusion.
translations.hindi: उस सुवणंमय सभाभवन में कोई क्षेसकर विचार करने के लिए बहुत से वीर भी एकत्र हुए थे

verses.sloka: ततो महात्मा विपुलम् सुयुग्यम् ।रथम् वरम् हेमविचित्रिताङ्गम् ।शुभम् समास्थाय ययौ यशस्वी ।विभीषणः सम्सदमग्रजस्य ॥६-११-२८॥।।
verses.transliteration: tato mahātmā vipulam suyugyam ।ratham varam hemavicitritāṅgam ।śubham samāsthāya yayau yaśasvī ।vibhīṣaṇaḥ samsadamagrajasya ॥6-11-28॥।।

translations.english: Thereafter illustrious and great Vibheeshana having ascended auspicious and choicest chariot decked with gold and yoked to good horses went to the assembly of his elder brother.
translations.hindi: राक्षसेन्द्र के उस रमणीक सभाभवन में राक्षसां के दल के दल एकत्र हुए । वे राक्षस राक्षासराज रावण को घेर कर बैठ गए

verses.sloka: स पूर्वजायावरजः शशम्स ।ना माथ पश्चाच्चरणौ ववन्दे ।शुकः प्रहस्तश्च तथैव तेभ्यो ।ददौ यथार्हम् प्R^थगासनानि ॥६-११-२९॥।।
verses.transliteration: sa pūrvajāyāvarajaḥ śaśamsa ।nā mātha paścāccaraṇau vavande ।śukaḥ prahastaśca tathaiva tebhyo ।dadau yathārham pR^thagāsanāni ॥6-11-29॥।।

translations.english: There after Vibheeshana the younger brother, repeated his name (by way of courtesy ). A fter that he offered salutations to his elder brother's feet. B oth Sukha and Prahastha likewise followed Vibheeshana and took their seats offered according to their position.

verses.sloka: सुवर्णनानामणिभुषणानाम् ।सुवाससाम् सम्सदि राक्षसानाम् ।तेषाम् परार्थ्यगुरुचन्दनानाम् ।स्रजाम् च गन्धाः प्रववुः समन्तात् ॥६-११-३०॥।।
verses.transliteration: suvarṇanānāmaṇibhuṣaṇānām ।suvāsasām samsadi rākṣasānām ।teṣām parārthyagurucandanānām ।srajām ca gandhāḥ pravavuḥ samantāt ॥6-11-30॥।।

translations.english: In that royal court decorated with different kinds of golden and gem colours, the Rakshasas attired in beautiful clothes with their body smeared with fragrance of incense and sandal paste and wearing floral garland s whose fragrance had spread all over.

verses.sloka: न चुक्रुशुर्नानृतमाह कश्चि ।त्सभासदो नापि जजल्पुरुच्चैः ।सम्सिद्धार्थः सर्व एवोग्रवीर्या ।भर्तुः सर्वे ददृशुश्चाननम् ते ॥६-११-३१॥।।
verses.transliteration: na cukruśurnānṛtamāha kaści ।tsabhāsado nāpi jajalpuruccaiḥ ।samsiddhārthaḥ sarva evogravīryā ।bhartuḥ sarve dadṛśuścānanam te ॥6-11-31॥।।

translations.english: Those who assembled at the royal court neither made a little noise, nor uttered untruth, nor spoke. All of them were fully accomplished, very heroic and looked at their Lord's face.
translations.hindi: विभीषण ने सभाभवन में पहुँच और अपना नास ले, बड़े भाई के चरणों में प्रणाम किआ। शुक और प्रहस्त सभा में समागत सभासदो को यथाक्रम अलग अलग आसना पर बिठाते थे ॥ २० Ut ८ सुवणुनाना पाणसूपणाना सुवाससां संसदि राचसानास्‌ । तेषां पराध्योगरुचन्दनानां स्तजश्च | 'गन्धाः प्र; समन्तात्‌

verses.sloka: स रावणः शस्त्रभृताम् मनस्विनाम् ।महाबलानाम् समितौ मनस्वी ।तप्याम् सभायाम् प्रभया चकाशे ।मध्ये वसूनामिव वज्रहस्तः ॥६-११-३२॥
verses.transliteration: sa rāvaṇaḥ śastrabhṛtām manasvinām ।mahābalānām samitau manasvī ।tapyām sabhāyām prabhayā cakāśe ।madhye vasūnāmiva vajrahastaḥ ॥6-11-32॥

translations.english: In that assembly, amid those heroes of great prowess, who held arms, Ravana glowed like Indra, who wields a diamond bolt in battle among the Vasus. ।।इत्यार्षेवाल्मीकीयेश्रीमद्रामायणेआदिकाव्येयुद्धकाण्डेएकादशस्सर्गः ।। This is the end of the eleventh sarga of Yuddha Kanda of the first epic the holy Ramayana composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: वहाँ सभा में बैठे सब चुपचाप थे--न तो कोई कुछ कहता था और न कोई बकवाद ही करता था । किसी के मुख से उच्च स्वर से कोई बात नहीं निकलती थी । क्योंकि वे सव राक्षस सफल मनोरथ तेजस्वी और पराक्रमी थे वे तो रावण के मुख को ताक रहे थे
